construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

Notice of Exemption: demolition of two existing detached residences and construction of an eight-unit condominium project, about 8,554 sq ft of gross floor area and 13 parking spaces; six market-rate units, one below-market-rate unit and one additional market-rate unit under State Density Bonus Law. Site is 10,995 sq ft, zoned R-3. Applicant and person carrying out the project: Farzad Ghafari.

Planning Commission notice (2024-04-15): substandard lot width; waivers requested for maximum FAR, maximum height and maximum driveway/parking paving; one lot to be subdivided into eight condominium parcels and one common area parcel. The Commission was the final decision-maker on the use permit, architectural control and BMR agreement and recommended to the City Council on the major subdivision.

SF YIMBY (2022-01-15) describes the applicant as a Sunnyvale-based individual and the project as filed under SB 330 and the State Density Bonus Law. SF YIMBY (2025-07-12) reports building permits filed, naming LPMD Architects; its body text gives the address as 1120 Hoover Street.
